stemMd: Two perpendicular displacement vectors have magnitudes 5 m and 12 m. What is the magnitude of their sum?
explanationMd: Perpendicular components form a right triangle. The resultant magnitude is the square root of 5 squared+12 squared, or 13 m. Direction determines how magnitudes combine.

distractorRationale.d: This multiplies magnitudes without vector geometry.
distractorRationale.e: This subtracts magnitudes as though directions were opposite.
distractorRationale.c: This adds magnitudes as though directions were identical.
